newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAI cuts variable home loan rate 0.25 pts.
newsitem.headline: FAI cuts variable home loan rate 0.25 pts.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd's wholly-owned subsidiary FAI Home Loans said on Friday it has cut its standard variable home loan rate by 0.25 points to 6.64 percent.

"We have been able to facilitate this cut due to the favourable figures released recently, our own view on the overall future of the interest rate regime in Australia and the success of our recent residential mortgage trust which raised A$240 million to provide further finance for our clients," FAI said in a statement.
Second quarter wages and inflation data earlier this week fuelled speculation of another cut in official interest rates, now at 5.5 percent.
Most analysts expect that reduction to come after the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) next monthly board meeting on August 5.
